title: Greetings and Introductions
summary: Exchange greetings, introduce yourself and others, respond politely, start conversations, and say goodbye across formal and familiar settings.

phrases.en: I'm well, praise be to God.
My full name is Rahim Ahmed.
I am from the United States.
I can speak a little Bengali.

phrases.bn: আপনার সঙ্গে পরিচিত হয়ে ভালো লাগল।
phrases.pronunciation: aponar shonge pôrichito hoye bhalo laglo

phrases.bn: আপনার সঙ্গে দেখা হয়ে ভালো লাগল।
phrases.pronunciation: aponar shonge dekha hoye bhalo laglo

phrases.bn: তোমার সঙ্গে দেখা হয়ে ভালো লাগল।
phrases.pronunciation: tomar shonge dekha hoye bhalo laglo

phrases.en: I saw you after a long time.

words.en: is not there / does not have

phrases.en: What do you do for work?
How long have you been learning Bengali?
Could you speak a little more slowly?

practice: Say the Bengali words for three items from greetings and introductions.
Read each phrase aloud, then repeat it without looking at the transliteration.
Create a new sentence by replacing one word in a lesson phrase.
notes: Use নমস্কার in broadly polite settings; সালাম is also common among Bengali Muslims.
আপনি is the respectful form of ‘you’.
